description: Trigger evals for design-bootstrap: it fires when a new project has a Figma file and no design system docs yet, while extract-foundations-from-screens, foundation-audit, screen-spec and inventory-snapshot handle token convergence from written specs, drift checks against existing docs, one screen, and a component library snapshot.
